metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 8 inches in Canberra, Australia during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Canberra, Australia (approximately -35.28, 149.13) - Date range: January 14-22, 2020 - Collection: CHIRPS daily precipitation data (good global coverage) or GPM IMERG - Need to sum total rainfall over the period 2. Masking strategy: - Precipitation data typically doesn't need cloud masking - Just sum the precipitation values over the date range 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If calculation succeeds and rainfall < 8 inches, answer B - If calculation succeeds and rainfall >= 8 inches, answer A - C1: If no images found in collection - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: If result is None/NaN or invalid (e.g., negative precipitation) - Note: 8 inches = ~203.2 mm ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const canberra = ee.Geometry.Point([149.13, -35.28]); const startDate = '2020-01-14'; const endDate = '2020-01-23'; // Exclusive end date const inches_threshold = 8; const mm_threshold = inches_threshold * 25.4; // 203.2 mm // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Using CHIRPS daily precipitation let collection = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(canberra); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found for the date range."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum all precipitation const totalPrecip = collection.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Calculate total rainfall at the point const result = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: canberra, scale: 5566, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const precipMm = result.precipitation; // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canberra, scale: 5566, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo().precipitation; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (precipMm < 0) { console.log("Invalid precipitation value (negative)."); console.log("C3"); return; } const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall: ${precipMm.toFixed(2)} mm (${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${inches_threshold} inches (${mm_threshold.toFixed(2)} mm)`); if (precipInches >= inches_threshold) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
